info.name: Tags API 🏷️🏷️🏷️
info.description:
- Endpoint: `GET /tag1/api.{json|xml}` - domains related to IPs and site attributes.
- Example: `https://api.builtwith.com/tag1/api.json?KEY=YOUR_KEY&LOOKUP=IP-1.2.3.4`
- Credits: 1 per lookup.

Updated 2026-11-10 from https://api.builtwith.com/llms-full.txt. Set KEY locally. Requests are examples; sending data requests may consume credits. Optional query parameters are disabled until selected.

request.description: Get IP Address usage for a tag.
